# Abandoned Village

Type: Structure | Internal ID: WoodFarm1 | Location: Meadows | Resources: Meadows chest, ,, Wild Beehive, ,, Raspberries | Inhabitants: Boar

# Introduction

Abandoned Villages, also referred has Abandoned Farms, are Point of interest found in the Meadows. They commonly spawn with 2–5 buildings and a couple of broken garden plots.
For lone houses found in the Meadows, see Abandoned House. See Draugr Village if Draugr inhabit the village.

## Farm House

The houses come in three variants. One always has a Meadows chest and a 20% chance to spawn a Wild Beehive. Another has a 90% chance for a chest and the same 20% chance for a beehive. The third offers no notable resources, but all variants can include an unusable Bed.

## Small structures

Abandoned Farms can also have various small wooded structures. A few Boars have a chance to inhabitant this structures.
